No. HQ-C11011/1/2026-C-1 (E-14486)
Government of India
Department of Personnel & Training
Staff Selection Commission (HQ)
*****
Subject: Declaration of Final Result of Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level
Examination, 2025 (CHSLE) – regarding.
Commission declared First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) for candidates of
CHSLE-2025 vide result Write-up No. HQ-C11011/1/2026-C-1 (E-14486) dated 17.08.2026.
Thereafter, candidates were required to participate mandatorily in the Sliding/Identity
Verification (IV) process through designated login module on the website of the Commission
conducted from 01.09.2026 to 03.09.2026.
2. As per Para 15 of FRTA write up dated 17.08.2026, any candidate who failed to
attend the sliding process physically has been treated as absent and not considered for the
final result.
3. The category wise breakup of vacancies (as also declared in FRTA) is as under:
EWS SC ST OBC UR Total ESM OH HH VH PwD
Others
Vacancies 337 490 252 768 1675 3522 301 35 43 39 37
4. Details of number of candidates who have opted Fix/Float and new allocations made
against the vacancies created due to absence of candidates in Sliding/Identity Verification
process are as under:
FIX 2260
FLOAT 927
NEW ALLOCATION (against absent candidates) 328
Total 3515
5. As per the provisions of the Notice of Examination, allocation of posts to eligible
candidates has been made on the basis of merit-cum-preference of posts submitted by the
candidates online and FIX/FLOAT option exercised by candidates in Sliding/Identity
Verification process. A total of 3515 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted in the
final result of CHSLE-2025. Category-wise breakup of provisionally recommended
candidates is as follows:
EWS SC ST OBC UR Total ESM OH HH VH PwD-Others
Vacancies 337 490 252 768 1675 3522 301 35 43 39 37

6. Post-wise and category-wise break-up of candidates provisionally shortlisted for
different posts against the vacancies reported by the User departments and cut-off details of
the last selected candidates against each post is given below. In cases where candidates are
shortlisted against horizontal categories (i.e. 3-ESM, 4-OH, 5-HH, 7-VH and 8-PwD-Others),
marks and Date of Birth of such last selected candidate are reflected against their respective
horizontal category in the Table(s) below and not against their vertical category (i.e. 0-EWS,
1- SC, 2-ST, 6-OBC and 9-UR). In addition to this, vacancies of horizontal categories are
also counted in their respective vertical categories.
